source.title: Scramble Accountability Policy Announcement (August 2021)
source.content:
The WCA Quality Assurance Committee has implemented the [Scramble Accountability Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Scramble%20Accountability.pdf) through discussion and collaboration with the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) and feedback from the Board, Senior Delegates, and Committee/Team Leaders.

The purpose of this policy is to define standards of how official WCA Scrambles must be treated and will be enforced by the WRC. The policy is targeted towards WCA Delegates and competition organization teams for giving instructions on how they ensure scramble integrity through the standards of scrambles and scrambling, and venue setup standards. 

We welcome your thoughts and questions through a post on the [WCA Forum](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/wca-quality-assurance/18) or an email to [quality@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:quality@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: 《打乱责任政策》发布（2021 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 质量保证委员会与 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）讨论合作，并征求董事会、高级代表及委员会/团队负责人的意见后，现已实施《[打乱责任政策](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Scramble%20Accountability.pdf)》。

这份政策规定了 WCA 官方打乱必须遵循的管理标准，由 WRC 负责执行。政策面向 WCA 代表和比赛组织团队，通过打乱公式、打乱操作及场地布置的标准，说明如何保障打乱的公正与保密。

欢迎通过 [WCA 论坛](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/wca-quality-assurance/18)发帖，或发邮件至 [quality@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:quality@worldcubeassociation.org)，提出意见和问题。
